title: Verbosa
excerpt: Multi-provider chat to use OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models from a single interface, in Flutter with a Go backend.

data.text: In 2025 I wanted a single chat to use OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and OpenRouter models, picking the model message by message. Flutter frontend for desktop and mobile, Go backend with WebSockets for streaming, conversations organized by project.

image_captions: Multi-provider AI chat interface with dynamic model selection and real-time streaming
